premarket.market_expectations: Global markets show strong overnight gains, with US indices rising sharply and Treasury yields edging higher. The dollar strengthens slightly while foreign investors remain net sellers in Indian markets. Crude prices pull back from recent highs. Given neutral bias and normal conviction levels, markets may consolidate after recent moves, with earnings reports and global cues likely driving direction. The rupee faces pressure from dollar strength and foreign outflows.
